name: GetApplicationSsoConfig

ApplicationSsoConfig.description_en: The single sign-on (SSO) configuration information of the application
ApplicationSsoConfig.description_zh: 应用单点登录SSO配置信息

InitLoginType.description_en:
The initialization single sign-on (SSO) method. Valid values:
only_app_init_sso: Only application-initiated SSO. This is the default value for OIDC protocol applications. When a SAML application specifies this method, InitLoginUrl must be specified.
idaas_or_app_init_sso: IDaaS portal-initiated or application-initiated SSO. This is the default value for SAML protocol applications. When an OIDC application specifies this method, InitLoginUrl must be specified
InitLoginType.description_zh:
初始化单点登录SSO方式，取值可选范围：
only_app_init_sso：仅应用发起SSO，OIDC协议应用默认取值。当SAML应用指定为该方式时，InitLoginUrl必须指定。
idaas_or_app_init_sso：支持IDaaS门户或者应用发起SSO，SAML协议应用默认取值范围。当OIDC协议指定为该方式时，InitLoginUrl必须指定

InitLoginUrl.description_en: The initialization single sign-on (SSO) trigger URL. This parameter is required when the InitLoginType of an OIDC protocol application is set to idaas_or_app_init_sso, or when the InitLoginType of a SAML protocol application is set to only_app_init_sso
InitLoginUrl.description_zh: 初始化单点登录SSO触发地址，当OIDC协议应用InitLoginType为idaas_or_app_init_sso，必须指定；当SAML协议应用InitLoginType为only_app_init_sso时，必须指定
InitLoginUrl.title_en: 仅SP-init情况下，SP指定的登录地址
InitLoginUrl.title_zh: 仅SP-init情况下，SP指定的登录地址

OidcSsoConfig.description_en: The SSO configuration parameters for OIDC protocol applications. This parameter is returned only when the application SSO protocol is OIDC
OidcSsoConfig.description_zh: OIDC协议的应用SSO属性配置参数。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回

AccessTokenEffectiveTime.description_en: The validity period of the issued access token. Unit: seconds. Default value: 1200 (20 minutes)
AccessTokenEffectiveTime.description_zh: 签发的access token有效时间，单位为秒，默认1200秒（20分钟）

AllowedPublicClient.description_en: Specifies whether the application is allowed to request the IDaaS EIAM authorization server as a public client. This parameter can be enabled only in authorization code mode and device mode. Default value: false
AllowedPublicClient.description_zh: 应用是否允许作为公共客户端请求IDaaS EIAM授权服务器。只支持授权码模式和设备模式启用，默认为false

CodeEffectiveTime.description_en: The validity period of the issued code. Unit: seconds. Default value: 60 (1 minute)
CodeEffectiveTime.description_zh: 签发的code有效时间，单位为秒，默认为60秒（1分钟）

CustomClaims.description_en: The custom user information included in the ID token response
CustomClaims.description_zh: 自定义id token返回包含的用户信息

ClaimName.description_en: The name of the returned claim

ClaimValueExpression.description_en: The value expression of the returned claim

GrantScopes.description_en: The OIDC standard parameter scope, which specifies the range of user attributes that can be returned by the userinfo endpoint or ID token
GrantScopes.description_zh: OIDC协议标准参数 scope，用于指定userinfo端点或者id_token可以返回的用户属性范围

items.description_en:
The OIDC standard parameter scope, which specifies the range of user attributes that can be returned by the userinfo endpoint or ID token. Valid values:
openid: OIDC standard parameter. The unique user ID.
profile: Detailed user information.
email: User email information.
phone: User phone information
items.description_zh:
OIDC协议标准参数 scope，用于指定userinfo端点或者id_token可以返回的用户属性范围，取值可选范围：
openid：OIDC标准参数，用户唯一id。
profile：用户详细信息。
email：用户邮箱信息。
phone：用户手机信息

GrantTypes.description_en: The list of supported OIDC protocol grant types
GrantTypes.description_zh: 支持的OIDC协议授权模式列表

items.description_en:
The supported OIDC protocol grant type. Valid values:
authorization_code: Authorization code mode.
implicit: Implicit mode.
refresh_token: Token refresh mode.
urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code: Device mode.
password: Password mode
items.description_zh:
支持的OIDC协议授权模式，取值可选范围：
authorization_code：授权码模式。
implicit：隐式模式。
refresh_token：令牌刷新模式。
urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code：设备模式。
password：密码模式

IdTokenEffectiveTime.description_en: The validity period of the issued ID token. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300 (5 minutes)
IdTokenEffectiveTime.description_zh: 签发的id token有效时间，单位为秒，默认为300秒（5分钟）

PasswordAuthenticationSourceId.description_en: The ID of the identity authentication source used in password mode. This parameter takes effect only when the GrantTypes specified for the OIDC protocol application include the password mode
PasswordAuthenticationSourceId.description_zh: 密码模式使用的身份认证源ID，当且仅当OIDC协议应用指定的GrantTypes包含password模式才生效
PasswordAuthenticationSourceId.title_en: 密码模式使用的身份认证来源id
PasswordAuthenticationSourceId.title_zh: 密码模式使用的身份认证来源id

PasswordTotpMfaRequired.description_en: Specifies whether TOTP-based secondary authentication is required in password mode. This parameter takes effect only when the GrantTypes specified for the OIDC protocol application include the password mode
PasswordTotpMfaRequired.description_zh: 密码模式是否强制需要TOTP二次认证，当且仅当OIDC协议应用指定的GrantTypes包含password模式才生效
PasswordTotpMfaRequired.title_en: 密码模式是否强制需要TOTP二次认证
PasswordTotpMfaRequired.title_zh: 密码模式是否强制需要TOTP二次认证

PkceChallengeMethods.description_en: The algorithm used to calculate the Code Challenge in PKCE

items.description_en:
The algorithm used to calculate the Code Challenge in PKCE. Valid values:
plain: Plain text.
S256: SHA-256 algorithm
items.description_zh:
PKCE中计算Code Challenge的算法，取值可选范围：
plain：原文。
S256：SHA 256算法

PkceRequired.description_en: Specifies whether the application SSO requires PKCE (RFC 7636)

PostLogoutRedirectUris.description_en: The list of logout callback addresses supported by the application
PostLogoutRedirectUris.description_zh: 应用支持Logout登出回调地址列表

items.description_en: The whitelisted logout callback address of the application. The post_logout_redirect_uri parameter can be specified when the application initiates a logout request
items.description_zh: 应用的Logout登出回调白名单地址，应用发起Logout请求时可以指定post_logout_redirect_uri参数

RedirectUris.description_en: The list of redirect URIs supported by the application

items.description_en: The redirect URI supported by the application

RefreshTokenEffective.description_en: The validity period of the issued refresh token. Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400 (1 day)
RefreshTokenEffective.description_zh: 签发的refresh token有效时间，单位为秒，默认为86400秒（1天）

ResponseTypes.description_en: The response types supported by the application when OidcSsoConfig.GrantTypes includes the implicit mode
ResponseTypes.description_zh: 当OidcSsoConfig.GrantTypes包含指定implicit隐式模式后，应用支持的返回类型

items.description_en:
The OIDC standard parameter ResponseType. This parameter takes effect only when GrantTypes includes the implicit mode. Valid values:
token: Only the access token is returned.
id_token: Only the ID token is returned.
token id_token: Both the access token and ID token are returned
items.description_zh:
OIDC协议标准参数ResponseType，只有指定了GrantTypes包含implicit隐式模式才生效，取值可选范围：
token：只返回access token。
id_token：只返回id token。
token id_token：同时返回access token和id token

ResponseTypes.title_en: 隐式流支持的返回类型
ResponseTypes.title_zh: 隐式流支持的返回类型

SubjectIdExpression.description_en: The custom expression for the sub value returned in the ID token
SubjectIdExpression.description_zh: 自定义id token返回的sub取值表达式

ProtocolEndpointDomain.description_en: The metadata endpoint configuration provided by the application
ProtocolEndpointDomain.description_zh: 应用提供的Metadata 端点配置信息

Oauth2AuthorizationEndpoint.description_en: The OAuth 2.0 authorization endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application SSO protocol is OIDC
Oauth2AuthorizationEndpoint.description_zh: oAuth2 授权端点。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回

Oauth2DeviceAuthorizationEndpoint.description_en: The OAuth 2.0 device authorization endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application SSO protocol is OIDC
Oauth2DeviceAuthorizationEndpoint.description_zh: oAuth2 Device 授权端点。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回

Oauth2RevokeEndpoint.description_en: The OAuth 2.0 token revocation endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application SSO protocol is OIDC
Oauth2RevokeEndpoint.description_zh: oAuth2 Token吊销端点。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回
Oauth2RevokeEndpoint.title_en: OIDC access token 吊销端点
Oauth2RevokeEndpoint.title_zh: OIDC access token 吊销端点

Oauth2TokenEndpoint.description_en: The OAuth 2.0 token endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application SSO protocol is OIDC
Oauth2TokenEndpoint.description_zh: oAuth2 Token端点。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回
Oauth2TokenEndpoint.title_en: oauth2 access token 换取端点
Oauth2TokenEndpoint.title_zh: oauth2 access token 换取端点

Oauth2UserinfoEndpoint.description_en: The OIDC user information endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application SSO protocol is OIDC
Oauth2UserinfoEndpoint.description_zh: OIDC 获取用户信息端点。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回
Oauth2UserinfoEndpoint.title_en: OIDC 获取用户信息端点
Oauth2UserinfoEndpoint.title_zh: OIDC 获取用户信息端点

OidcIssuer.description_en: The OIDC issuer information. This parameter is returned only when the application SSO protocol is OIDC
OidcIssuer.description_zh: OIDC issuer信息。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回

OidcJwksEndpoint.description_en: The OIDC JWKS endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application SSO protocol is OIDC
OidcJwksEndpoint.description_zh: OIDC jwks地址。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回

OidcLogoutEndpoint.description_en: The OIDC RP-initiated logout endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application SSO protocol is OIDC
OidcLogoutEndpoint.description_zh: OIDC RP-initiated Logout Endpoint。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回

SamlMetaEndpoint.description_en: The SAML protocol metadata endpoint URL. This parameter is returned only when the application SSO protocol is SAML 2.0
SamlMetaEndpoint.description_zh: SAML协议的Metadata元数据地址。当且仅当应用SSO协议为SAML 2.0时返回

SamlSloEndpoint.description_en: The SAML single logout URL (SLO URL) on the IdP side. The SP redirects the user to this URL to initiate single logout
SamlSloEndpoint.description_zh: IdP侧的SAML单点登出地址（SLO URL），SP将用户重定向至该地址发起单点登出

SamlSsoEndpoint.description_en: The SAML protocol AuthnRequest receiving endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application SSO protocol is SAML 2.0
SamlSsoEndpoint.description_zh: SAML协议AuthnRequest请求接受地址。当且仅当应用SSO协议为SAML 2.0时返回

SamlSsoConfig.description_en: The SSO configuration parameters for SAML protocol applications. This parameter is returned only when the application SSO protocol is SAML 2.0
SamlSsoConfig.description_zh: SAML协议的应用SSO属性配置参数。当且仅当应用SSO协议为SAML 2.0时返回

AssertionSigned.description_en:
Specifies whether the assertion needs to be signed. ResponseSigned and AssertionSigned cannot both be set to false.
true: Signed.
false: Not signed
AssertionSigned.description_zh:
Assertion是否需要签名。ResponseSigned和AssertionSigned不能同时为false。
true：需要签名。
false：不需要签名

AttributeStatements.description_en: The additional user attribute configuration included in the SAML assertion
AttributeStatements.description_zh: 在SAML断言中包含的额外用户属性配置

AttributeName.description_en: The Name of the attribute in the SAML assertion

AttributeValueExpression.description_en: The attribute value expression in the SAML assertion
AttributeValueExpression.description_zh: SAML断言中的属性取值表达式

DefaultRelayState.description_en: The default RelayState value. When the single sign-on (SSO) request is initiated by EIAM, the SAML Response provided by EIAM specifies the RelayState as this value. This applies when the user logon request is initiated by EIAM
DefaultRelayState.description_zh: 默认RelayState取值。当用户的单点登录SSO请求是由EIAM发起时，EIAM提供的SAML Response会指定RelayState为当前值

IdPEntityId.description_en: The Entity ID that represents the IdP identity in the SAML protocol
IdPEntityId.description_zh: SAML协议中代表IdP身份的Entity Id

NameIdFormat.description_en:
The NameID format defined by the SAML protocol standard. Valid values:
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified: Unspecified. The application determines how to parse the NameID.
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress: Email address format.
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent: Persistent NameID.
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient: Transient NameID
NameIdFormat.description_zh:
SAML协议标准的NameID格式，取值可选范围：
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified：未指定的，由应用自行决定解析NameID。
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress：Email地址格式。
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent：持久化的NameID。
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient：瞬时的NameID

NameIdValueExpression.description_en: The expression used to generate the actual NameID value in the SAML protocol
NameIdValueExpression.description_zh: SAML协议的NameID真实取值生成表达式

OptionalRelayStates.description_en: The optional RelayState values. In the application portal, the application card displays multiple optional redirect addresses with display names. After a user clicks an address and completes SSO, the user is automatically redirected to the corresponding address. You can specify optional redirect addresses only after you specify a default redirect address
OptionalRelayStates.description_zh: 可选的RelayState。用户在应用门户的应用卡片中，显示多个可选跳转地址的显示名称，用户点击并完成 SSO 后，自动跳转到对应地址。需要填写默认跳转地址后才可填写

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the RelayState

RelayState.description_en: The optional RelayState value. In the application portal, the application card displays multiple optional redirect addresses with display names. After a user clicks an address and completes SSO, the user is automatically redirected to the corresponding address
RelayState.description_zh: 可选的RelayState。用户在应用门户的应用卡片中，显示多个可选跳转地址的显示名称，用户点击并完成 SSO 后，自动跳转到对应地址

RequireAuthnRequestSigned.description_en: Indicates whether SSO AuthnRequest signature verification is enabled
RequireAuthnRequestSigned.description_zh: 返回当前SSO验签开关状态

ResponseSigned.description_en:
Indicates whether the Response needs to be signed. ResponseSigned and AssertionSigned cannot both be set to false. Valid values:
true: Signing is required.
false: Signing is not required
ResponseSigned.description_zh:
Response是否需要签名。ResponseSigned和AssertionSigned不能同时为false。
true：需要签名。
false：不需要签名

SignatureAlgorithm.description_en: The signature algorithm for the SAML assertion

SpEntityId.description_en: The SAML EntityId of the application (SP)

SpSigningCertificates.description_en: The configured SP signing verification certificates in PEM format. A maximum of two certificates are returned for the console or API caller to read and display
SpSigningCertificates.description_zh: 返回已配置的SP验签证书（PEM格式）数组，最多2个，供控制台/API调用方读取回显

items.description_en: The configured SP signing verification certificate in PEM format
items.description_zh: 已配置的SP验签证书（PEM格式）

SpSloResponseUrl.description_en: The configured SP SLO response URL
SpSloResponseUrl.description_zh: 返回已配置的SP SLO响应回发地址

SpSsoAcsUrl.description_en: The SAML Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL of the application (SP)

SsoStatus.description_en:
The SSO status of the application. Valid values:
enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled
SsoStatus.description_zh:
应用 SSO 功能启用状态，取值可选范围：
enabled：应用中。
disabled：禁用中
SsoStatus.title_en: 应用 SSO 启用状态
SsoStatus.title_zh: 应用 SSO 启用状态
